_comment: Divergences between a Drive filename date and lenders.json that have been looked at and settled. `scan` prints these as `ack` instead of STALE so the monthly report only shows things nobody has judged yet. Remove an entry when a new PDF arrives for that lender -- the question reopens. td and dfc were removed on 2026-08-26 once their Drive files were renamed to match the dates printed inside the documents. gls was removed on 2026-09-03: effectiveDate is now July 27, 2026 (v53), matching the filename.
